info.title: LLM Fingerprinting Backend — Stage 2 Local Prototype
info.description: Authenticated encrypted live jobs and mock jobs; explicit review-only Stage 2 mode.

post.description:
Synchronous OpenAI target interrogation; judge remains a mock.

This endpoint must be called only against localhost until authentication,
HTTPS, rate limiting, and job execution are implemented. API keys are
supplied per request and are NOT stored by the application.
Queue mock-only analysis; worker runs separately. Never accept keys.
Never put the user's provider key in the SQLite job payload.

AnalyzeRequest.title: AnalyzeRequest
AnalyzeRequest.description:
The UI supplies one prompt; never a response, probe list, or API key.

Unknown fields are rejected so that a user cannot accidentally post an
API key to this mock-only endpoint.

AnalyzeResponse.title: AnalyzeResponse
AnalyzeResponse.description: A completed synchronous MOCK report, not a live fingerprint result.

CreateLiveJobRequest.title: CreateLiveJobRequest

CreateMockJobRequest.title: CreateMockJobRequest
CreateMockJobRequest.description:
Only a prompt and Stage 1 flag; unknown fields (especially keys) rejected.

Stage 1 is not enabled in the mock worker because no confirmed baseline
store has been implemented; the route rejects that combination with 409.

LiveOpenAIAnalyzeRequest.title: LiveOpenAIAnalyzeRequest
LiveOpenAIAnalyzeRequest.description:
Per-analysis OpenAI key; never persisted or serialized in the result.

The model ID routes requests to a specific OpenAI deployment. It is NOT
supplied as a fingerprinting ground truth or predicted identity.

LiveOpenAIAnalyzeResponse.title: LiveOpenAIAnalyzeResponse
LiveOpenAIAnalyzeResponse.description: Real target responses; legacy mock or review-only Stage 2 evidence.

UnifiedLiveResult.title: UnifiedLiveResult
UnifiedLiveResult.description: Safe, typed UI result. Raw report remains for research diagnostics.
